ios.desc:
You have one bright green bottle cap. Can you trade your way to a house? A private jet? A space flight?

Infinite Swap drops you into a world of traders, deal-makers and oddballs — each with something they want, and something they'll let go. Walk into a flea market, a marina, a tech campus, an art district, and start swapping. A bottle cap becomes a vintage camera. The camera becomes a sailboat. The sailboat becomes a vintage Porsche. Where you end up is entirely up to you — and the deals you make.

And after every swap, Sal the Appraiser — a sharp-eyed pawnbroker who's seen it all — gives you his fully voiced verdict. Did you get a steal? Or did you just torch your fortune?

But not every trade goes up. Read a character wrong, jump on an offer that looked too sweet, and the fortune you spent an hour climbing can vanish in a single swap. Climb high, crash hard, dust yourself off, and try to read the next trader better than the last.

NO TWO PLAYTHROUGHS THE SAME

Every trader you meet, every item they own, every offer they make is generated fresh. The merchant who traded you a telescope last game might want something completely different this time. Play it once and you've seen one shape of the world. Play it ten times and you've still only scratched the surface.

37 UNIQUE CHARACTERS

A French circus performer running a curiosity shop. A retired Oxford historian downsizing her artefacts. A beach bodybuilder hunting gym equipment. A tech bro flexing rare mechanical keyboards. Every trader has their own personality and fully voiced reactions — and a hidden motivation that changes every game.

11 HANDCRAFTED LOCATIONS

Flea markets, art districts, university quarters, beaches, marinas, tech campuses and more. New locations unlock as you climb, opening doors to higher-stakes trades and richer characters.

PROGRESSIVE OBJECTIVES

Start by trading your way to a house. Then chase the private jet. The private island. The superyacht. The space flight. Earn medals at every milestone — and find out what waits beyond the stars.

YOUR COLLECTION

Every item you discover is catalogued forever. Sort by value, browse your journey, and watch your trades climb (or plummet) from cents to millions.

ONE BOTTLE CAP. INFINITE OUTCOMES. HOW FAR CAN YOU RIDE IT?

show_hn.title: Show HN: Infinite Swap – Trade a bottle cap up to a house

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

Infinite Swap is a game inspired by Kyle MacDonald’s One Red Paperclip and other bigger-and-better swap stories - you start with a green bottle cap and trade it with other characters in various locations all the way up to a house and beyond.

A while ago I got inspired by viral games Infinite Craft and What Beats Rock? and wanted to make my own ‘exploring a LLM’s latent space’ style challenge. After much experimentation this became a trading style game, where the LLM comes up with all the items, trading scenarios and value estimates, which ended up being surprisingly fun and somewhat of a roller coaster to play.

I found it was the most intriguing if I separated the item offer from its valuation - so I implemented a pricing oracle called “Sal” who gives this info with his, sometimes snarky, opinion after each trade.

The item offer mechanism goes deeper too - each character’s profile is combined with a set of hidden motivations. I then use embeddings and cosine similarity to represent the desire the character has for the player's item, and therefore what they are willing to offer in exchange.

Links to play:
iOS (small number of ads, polished): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/infinite-swap/id6761694545 
Android (small number of ads, polished): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.squizsoftware.infiniteswap&hl=en_US 
Web (no ads, a touch rougher than the mobile versions but still very functional): https://infiniteswap.app
